plugins.name: agentics
plugins.description: Code-orchestrated design, investigation and development over a generic codebase. All work is one execution tree: decomposed until atomic, executed by readiness in framework-owned worktrees, verified and reviewed by rigor, landed only on the user's go.

plugins.name: improve-clauding
plugins.description: Retrospective over recent Claude Code and Cursor sessions: separates the user's habits from agent/tool/model/router failures, reports patterns to fix and to endorse along six axes, and proposes rules, skill patches, skills, agents or hooks without applying them.

plugins.name: socratic
plugins.description: Adversarial N-agent debate as a decision aid: /socratic stress-tests a decision or design question and translates the outcome into a plain recommendation; /socratic-continue feeds the last debate a new point.

plugins.name: agent-tree
plugins.description: Live, zoomable graph of the session's subagents in a side pane: who spawned whom, what each is doing now, and a timeline of its tool calls. Select, center, collapse or stop agents; colors follow the Claude Code theme. /agent-tree opens it.
